title: Link
description: A generic sidequest entry: a tool, repo, article, book, course, community, job board, referral link, or anything else worth saving.

url.description: Canonical URL of the thing being saved.

category.description: Category slug. Must exist in taxonomy/categories.yaml with type: links, and must match the containing folder name.

tags.description: Free-form tags, normalized to lowercase-kebab. No registry.

date_added.description: ISO date. Must be quoted in YAML so it parses as a string, not a timestamp.

source.description: How this entry entered the repo.

note.description: Why you saved it, or the context you found it in.

description.description: One-line description shown on the card.

alternatives.description: Slugs of similar/alternative link entries. Rendered bidirectionally: if A lists B, B's page also shows A.

audience.description: Free-form audience labels, e.g. developers, non-technical, job-seekers, everyone.
